description: Fetch public Pinterest creator or verified merchant profile stats (follower count, verified merchant flag, aesthetic dominant palette, and recent top pins) by username or profile URL. Cost: 10 Credits / profile (0 Credits if 404).

username.description: Pinterest username (e.g. "pinterest" or "etsy") or full https://www.pinterest.com/<username>/ URL.

name: users_profile

data.description: Public Pinterest creator or verified merchant profile payload.

profile.description: Normalized profile object with username, follower/following counts, verified merchant flag, website domain, dominant palette, and recent pins.

meta.description: Request telemetry, credit billing, and cache status metadata.

cached.description: Whether the response was served from warm cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on cache-empty or error).

took_ms.description: End-to-end server processing latency in milliseconds.

title: Get Pinterest Creator or Brand Merchant Profile
